Name: Daily Summary
Author: parzival212
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Daily Summary adds a single hotkey (default [b]F5[/b]) that opens a tidy in-game popup recapping everything you've accomplished today: how much gold you earned and spent, what's piled up in the shipping bin, how much XP each skill has gained, monsters defeated, mine progress, and steps walked. No need to wait for the end-of-day shipping screen — check in anytime, then keep playing.
The popup is rendered in Stardew's native dialog-box style and closes with Escape or the close button.
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] (4.0.0 or newer).[/*]
[*]Download the latest version of Daily Summary from the Files tab.[/*]
[*]Unzip the download into your Stardew Valley\Mods  folder. [/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]One-key day recap.[/b] Press F5 anytime — the popup appears immediately.[/*]
[*][b]Gold tracking.[/b] Earned today, spent today, and current balance.[/*]
[*][b]Skill XP deltas.[/b] Per-skill XP gained since waking up (Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining, Combat).[/*]
[*][b]Shipping bin snapshot.[/b] Item count and total sell value of what's in the bin right now.[/*]
[*][b]Combat & exploration.[/b] Monsters defeated today, deepest mine level reached, total steps walked.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable hotkey.[/b] Change the key in config.json or via Generic Mod Config Menu in the in-game options.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer-friendly.[/b] Shows stats for the local player only.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — [i]optional[/i]. Lets you change the hotkey from the in-game settings menu instead of editing config.json[/*]
[/list]
